description: Amtrak station lookup by code or name — station name, 3-letter code, city/state, street address, timezone, coordinates, and how many trains are currently inbound. "Where is the Amtrak station in Denver?", "what is station code NYP". Example: amtrak_station_info({ station: "Denver" })

station.description: Amtrak station code (e.g. "DEN", "NYP") or station/city name (e.g. "Denver", "New York")
